zh: 发出消息时，气泡从输入框飞向消息列表的过程中看着不对：有时上半部分变浅成一条横带，有时消息下面多出一条更深的下划线，有时同一个消息的两份画面上下错开几十像素。原因都在替身（飞行的那个气泡）与它要替换的那一行之间：那一行在宿主手里还在移动（提交后对话滚到末尾、回显行被真实行换下、真实行自己还在长高），替身在落点没到位之前真实行就已经显形；替身的高度也取自宿主刚挂上的那一行，而那一行还在长高，于是替身比它要替换的那一行矮，淡出时只盖住气泡的上半段，露在外面的一段就是那一行自己的底色（看上去像一条下划线）；替身指向的目的地节点还会被宿主换掉，那时替身量不到落点，就停在半路不动了。现在替身每一帧都从它按住的那一行重新取目的地，高度按那一行当时的实际高度为准，底色按画面上的颜色写定（气泡底色是半透明令牌时与画布合成一次，压在气泡上不再叠出第二层）；真实行要等替身站到它上面、并且它自己连着几帧不动之后才显形，显形瞬间两者对齐到同一像素，淡出期间替身始终钉在那一行上（那几帧里那一行还会移动）。等待本身有两重上限：替身离那一行已经很近时缩短等待，落定后最多再等 0.5 秒，所以页面一直在动时也不会把消息一直扣着。落定的回弹从约 3.6 像素收到约 0.2 像素；替身起飞后离开页面的兜底时间相应放宽。
en: A sent bubble looked wrong on its way from the composer to the message list: sometimes its upper part came out pale as a band, sometimes a darker line appeared under the message, sometimes the same message showed twice, tens of pixels apart. All of it sits between the stand-in (the flying bubble) and the row it replaces. That row keeps moving in the host's hands (the transcript gliding to its tail after a submission, the echo row being swapped for the real one, a new row still growing), and the real row was shown before the stand-in had reached it. The stand-in's own height was taken from the row the host had just mounted, which was still growing, so it stood shorter than the row it replaced: as it faded across it covered only the bubble's upper part, and the part left outside kept that row's own fill, which reads as a line under the message. The destination node could also be replaced under the flight, and a stand-in that can no longer measure its row stops where it is. Now the destination is taken again every frame from the row the flight is holding, the height follows that row as it stands, and the fill is written as the colour the screen paints (a translucent bubble token is composited over the canvas once, so it no longer composites a second time over the bubble). The real row is shown only once the stand-in is on it and the row itself has held still for several frames — the two are the same pixel at that moment — and through the fade the stand-in stays pinned to the row, which can still move those few frames. The wait is bounded twice over: a stand-in already close to the row shortens it, and 0.5 s ends it, so a page that keeps moving never holds the message back. The landing's give is down from about 3.6px to about 0.2px, and the backstop that removes a stand-in whose row never arrives is widened to match.
